blocks.html: The permitted basic floor area ratio for community facility use is 1.25. The underlying district floor area ratio may be increased on any zoning lot by the amount set forth in Section 94-08 (Special Floor Area Bonus Provisions) or through transfer provisions pursuant to Section 94-094 (Authorization provisions for transfer of development rights to receiving lots) or by special permit pursuant to Section 94-095 (Special permit for floor area, location within buildings, building height and related parking modifications within Area G).
